pr_title: lightning: check hasDupe and tableID when resolve duplicate rows

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/40657

Problem Summary:

`ResolveDuplicateRows` may accidentally delete imported data even if there is no duplicate data is detected. See https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/40657#issuecomment-1386522583.

### What is changed and how it works?

Add two checks when deleting duplicate data:
1. Skip `ResolveDuplicateRows`  when no duplicate data is detected.
2. Check table id if before deleting duplicate data.

issue_context.title: Lightning ResolveDuplicateRows casue checksum mismatch
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
Table schema:
```sql
CREATE TABLE `t` (
     `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
     `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
     UNIQUE KEY `uni_name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;
```
Enable `duplicate-resolution` 
```
[tikv-importer]
backend = "local"
duplicate-resolution = "remove"
```

Use tidb-lightning to import data twice.

For the first time, import data with unique key conflicts.
```
id,name
1,"aaa01"
2,"aaa02"
3,"aaa03"
4,"aaa04"
5,"aaa04"
```
Conflict errors are detected as expected.
```
Import Data Error Summary: 
+---+---------------------+-------------+------------------------------------- ~
| # | ERROR TYPE          | ERROR COUNT | ERROR DATA TABLE                     ~
+---+---------------------+-------------+------------------------------------- ~
| 1 | Unique Key Conflict |          2 | `lightning_task_info`.`conflict_erro ~
+---+---------------------+-------------+------------------------------------- ~
```

For the second time, truncate the table and import data with no unique key conflicts.
```
id,name
1,"aaa01"
2,"aaa02"
3,"aaa03"
4,"aaa04"
5,"aaa05"
```
No conflict error is detected. But checksum mismatch is reported.


### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
After the table is truncated, import should complete without any error.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

checksum mismatch error is reported.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
master
comments:
In `processProcess`, when `duplicate-resolution` is enabled, lightning will always call `ResolveDuplicateRows` even if there is no duplicate data detected.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/5cb64fd09a99335c4588195c52e4e91884da6451/br/pkg/lightning/restore/table_restore.go#L815
In normal cases, it is ok. However, if we import data with duplicates to the table, then truncate the table and import data with no duplicates to the same table, we may encounter checksum mismatch error. This is because `ResolveDuplicateRows` will accidentally delete duplicate data that is detected during the first time we import.

review_comments: If it's not urgent to fix, can we add more information to conflict_error_v1 and other coordination tables like taskID, taskStartTime to filter the outdated duplicated records?

This fix will be cherry-picked to the released version like v6.5. It's better not to change the table schema. 
Although lightning records self-task ID, it's difficult to determine whether the records are inserted by other lightning instances during parallel import or just by a previous import.

Seems we also can't easily distinguish outdated conflict_error_v1 records in precheck, because it may belong to a parellel import instance?

We rely on the specific way to clean up data too much. If the user choose batch delete to clean the table for some reason (though it's almost impossible), this check will not work. But I also can't find another fix so almost lgtm.

> Seems we also can't easily distinguish outdated conflict_error_v1 records in precheck, because it may belong to a parellel import instance?

Yes.

> If the user choose batch delete to clean the table for some reason (though it's almost impossible), this check will not work.

Currently, duplicate detection doesn't work with increment import well. That is to say if users perform CRUD operations on the target table. Lightning's duplicate detection even may fail or return wrong results. For this scenario, there is still much work to do.
